3993612.note: After desilting in 2023-24, this village pond held water −0.5 weeks a year compared with 10 similar untreated waterbodies within 20 km, over 2023-24 and 2024-25. That is within the range untreated waterbodies show by chance, so no change can be told apart. A change smaller than one season may not show in seasonal data. 599 m³ of silt was removed, about 0.01 m over its area. Across 1 desilted village ponds in Gondia district, the average change is −0.5 weeks a year.
